package.description: Bloomberg-style stock dashboard with live quotes and optional API-backed news, SEC filings, and earnings data

en-US.description: Bloomberg-style stock dashboard with live quotes and optional API-backed news, SEC filings, and earnings data
en-US.longDescription: alphai-tui displays live market quotes through Yahoo Finance without an API key. AI-scored news, SEC filings, earnings, and calendar features require an AlphAI account and API key. AlphAI offers a limited free tier and paid subscription tiers. Optional Finnhub, Alpaca, and Tiingo quote sources require separate provider API keys.
en-US.name: alphai-tui
